messages.content:
Fuel consumption: (45 litres ÷ 360 km) × 100 = 12.5 L/100 km.

Interpretation: The vehicle used an average of 12.5 litres for every 100 km travelled. Lower L/100 km means better fuel efficiency.

Independent check: 360 ÷ 45 = 8 km per litre; 100 ÷ 8 = 12.5 L/100 km, confirming the result.
